title: India Test-Fires Nuclear-Capable Agni-4 Missile

blocks.content: India test-fired the nuclear-capable Agni-4 ballistic missile on 6 August 2026 from the Integrated Test Range at Chandipur, Odisha. The launch was conducted under the Strategic Forces Command, and the Ministry of Defence stated that all mission objectives and operational parameters were validated.

items: Agni-4 is classified by the Ministry of Defence as a Medium-Range Ballistic Missile.
Some media reports classify Agni-4 as an Intermediate-Range Ballistic Missile.
India follows a doctrine of credible minimum deterrence in its nuclear policy.
Ballistic missiles follow a high-arc trajectory and re-enter the atmosphere at high speed.
